old: After stems ending in two consonants or a long vowel + consonant, a linking vowel is inserted before -gat/-get: tisztít -> tisztogat ('to clean repeatedly/carefully'), írogat ('to jot down from time to time'), néz -> nézeget, töröl -> törölget.
